title: SAGE: Training Smart Any-Horizon Agents for Long Video Reasoning with Reinforcement Learning

layout.note: Two panels stacked top to bottom, long video (a) and short video (b). Each opens with Intent and Video Context boxes, then two framed lanes: a red Humans lane and a dark-teal SAGE (ours) lane. In (a) the SAGE lane is a snake-shaped chain of seven tool-call blocks; in (b) a mosaic of frames goes straight to Answer Prediction.

lesson: Motivate an agent design by drawing a human doing the task and the agent doing it in two aligned frames, and give each reasoning turn one colour reused on the human's arrows and notes, the thumbnails and the agent's tool calls. A second, trivial panel (one arrow) shows the same system skipping the loop on the easy case.
